 ROOT[\"<b>UAV-PMS</b><br/>(Core Platform)\"]:::rootStyle

 %% Branch 1: Identity and RBAC

 F1 --> F1_2[\"Manage User Accounts and Roles\"]:::leafStyle
 F1 --> F1_3[\"Enforce Role-based Access Control\"]:::leafStyle

 F2 --> F2_2[\"Manage GIS Coordinates\"]:::leafStyle
 F2 --> F2_3[\"Visualize Assets on Map\"]:::leafStyle
 F2 --> F2_4[\"View Asset Inspection & History\"]:::leafStyle

 %% Branch 3: Mission Management
 F3[\"<b>Mission Management</b>\"]:::catStyle

 F3 --> F3_1[\"Check Drone & Workforce Availability\"]:::leafStyle
 F3 --> F3_2[\"Create and Assign Inspection Mission\"]:::leafStyle
 F3 --> F3_3[\"Track Mission Status\"]:::leafStyle
 F3 --> F3_4[\"Complete Mission\"]:::leafStyle

 %% Branch 4: In-flight Inspection / Edge AI

 F4 --> F4_1[\"Start Field Inspection\"]:::leafStyle
 F4 --> F4_2[\"Capture Media and Telemetry\"]:::leafStyle
 F4 --> F4_3[\"Detect Emergency Anomalies In-flight\"]:::leafStyle

 %% Branch 5: Post-flight Inspection Data / Cloud AI

 F5 --> F5_1[\"Upload Inspection Media\"]:::leafStyle
 F5 --> F5_2[\"Process Post-flight Cloud AI Analysis\"]:::leafStyle
 F5 --> F5_3[\"Store AI Detection Results\"]:::leafStyle
 F5 --> F5_4[\"Display Bounding Boxes & Confidence\"]:::leafStyle

 %% Branch 6: Analyst Validation

 ROOT --> F6

 F6 --> F6_2[\"Confirm or Reject Defects\"]:::leafStyle
 F6 --> F6_3[\"Request Reanalysis\"]:::leafStyle
 F6 --> F6_4[\"Escalate Critical Defects\"]:::leafStyle

 %% Branch 7: Maintenance Ticket Management

 F7 --> F7_2[\"Assign Technician\"]:::leafStyle
 F7 --> F7_3[\"Update Ticket Status\"]:::leafStyle
 F7 --> F7_4[\"Verify and Close Ticket\"]:::leafStyle

 F8[\"<b>Reporting and Export</b>\"]:::catStyle

 F8 --> F8_1[\"View Operational Dashboard\"]:::leafStyle
 F8 --> F8_2[\"Filter Reports by Mission, Asset, Defect\"]:::leafStyle
 F8 --> F8_3[\"Export CSV, Excel, PDF\"]:::leafStyle",
